use std::future::Future;
use std::pin::Pin;
use std::task::{Context, Poll, RawWaker, RawWakerVTable, Waker};

pub fn run<F: Future>(f: F) -> F::Output {
    fn noop(_: *const ()) {}
    fn clone(_: *const ()) -> RawWaker { RawWaker::new(std::ptr::null(), &VT) }
    static VT: RawWakerVTable = RawWakerVTable::new(clone, noop, noop, noop);
    let w = unsafe { Waker::from_raw(RawWaker::new(std::ptr::null(), &VT)) };
    let mut cx = Context::from_waker(&w);
    let mut f = std::pin::pin!(f);
    loop { if let Poll::Ready(v) = f.as_mut().poll(&mut cx) { return v; } }
}

pub fn simple() -> u32 {
    let c = async |x: u32| {
        if x > 1 { x } else { 0 }
    };
    run(c(2)) + run(c(0))
}

pub fn inner_things() -> u32 {
    let c = async |x: u32| {
        let k = |v: u32| v + 1;
        let b = async { k(x) };
        b.await
    };
    run(c(1))
}

pub fn moved(y: u32) -> u32 {
    let c = async move |x: u32| {
        if x > y { x } else { y }
    };
    run(c(3))
}

pub async fn in_async_fn(y: u32) -> u32 {
    let c = async |x: u32| {
        if x > y { x } else { y }
    };
    c(5).await
}

pub fn nested() -> u32 {
    let outer = async |x: u32| {
        let inner = async |z: u32| {
            if z > 1 { z } else { 0 }
        };
        inner(x).await
    };
    run(outer(4))
}

#[test]
fn t() {
    assert!(simple() > 0);
    assert!(inner_things() > 0);
    assert!(moved(1) > 0);
    assert!(run(in_async_fn(1)) > 0);
    assert!(nested() > 0);
}
